component.name: WinOnLinux
component.summary: Connect to Windows 365 Cloud PCs and Azure Virtual Desktop

description.p: WinOnLinux is a Linux desktop client for Windows 365 Cloud PCs and Azure Virtual Desktop. Sign in with your Microsoft Entra ID work account, see your Cloud PCs and AVD resources in one place, and connect through the browser-based web client. Cloud PC management actions (restart, rename, troubleshoot, reset) are built in.
Native (FreeRDP-based) sessions are planned; this release connects via the web client. A system keyring is required for secure sign-in storage.
Phase 0: sign-in, Cloud PC and AVD bookmark enumeration, web launch, Cloud PC management actions.
